findings.evidence: A grep for `^@\[expose\] public section` in TauCeti/Algebra/Polynomial finds no matches; Taylor.lean:50 uses plain `public section`.
findings.fix: Use `public section` and prove the defeq lemmas (`taylorJet_apply`, `hermiteJet_apply`, `taylorJetQuotientEquiv_mk`, `hermiteQuotientEquiv_mk`, `hermiteJetEquiv_apply`, `hermiteJet_eq_taylorJetQuotientEquiv`) with `(rfl)`.
findings.issue: `@[expose] public section` exposes the bodies of `taylorJet`, `taylorJetQuotientEquiv`, `hermiteJet`, `hermiteModulus`, `ordinaryHermiteJet`, `hermiteQuotientEquiv`, `hermiteJetEquiv` and `hermiteBasis`. Consumers only need the `_apply`/`_mk` lemmas, and no `TauCeti/Algebra/Polynomial` file uses `@[expose]`.

findings.evidence: TauCeti/Algebra/LinearRecurrence/ClosedForm.lean:163 has `have (θ : s) : Module.Finite K (degreeLT K (m θ)) := .equiv (degreeLTEquiv K (m θ)).symm`, the same construction as line 145 here.
findings.fix: Move the instance and `map_mem_degreeLT` to a degreeLT file such as TauCeti/RingTheory/Polynomial/DegreeLT.lean, move the `taylorJet` family to TauCeti/Algebra/Polynomial/Taylor.lean, and replace the local `have` in ClosedForm.lean with the instance.
findings.issue: General results are kept in the Hermite file: `instModuleFiniteDegreeLT` and `map_mem_degreeLT` mention only Mathlib types, and `taylorJet`, `taylorJet_eq_zero_iff`, `taylorJet_surjective`, `ker_taylorJet` and `taylorJetQuotientEquiv` (lines 69-104) work over any commutative ring and never use Hermite nodes. They are hard to find here, and other files already rebuild the instance by hand.

findings.evidence: Line 245: `exact congr_fun (congr_fun ((hermiteJetEquiv m ha).apply_symm_apply c) i) k`; line 155 has no `@[simp]`, while `hermiteJet_apply` at line 113 does.
findings.fix: Add `@[simp] theorem hermiteJet_hermiteJetEquiv_symm (ha) (c) : hermiteJet a m ((hermiteJetEquiv m ha).symm c) = c`, and tag `ordinaryHermiteJet_apply` with `@[simp]`.
findings.issue: The interpolation polynomial `(hermiteJetEquiv m ha).symm c` has no `simp` lemma saying its jets are `c`. Proofs have to unfold through `apply_symm_apply` and `congr_fun`, as `existsUnique_hermite_interpolation` does at lines 244-245 and `hermiteJetEquiv_symm_map` at line 289. Separately, `ordinaryHermiteJet_apply` (line 155) is the normal form of `ordinaryHermiteJet` but is not tagged `@[simp]`, unlike `hermiteJet_apply`.

summary: The whole file sits in `@[expose] public section` although consumers can use the `_apply` lemmas instead of unfolding, and three general results (a degreeLT instance, a degreeLT lemma, the Taylor-jet maps) are kept in the Hermite file instead of their canonical homes. The characteristic API is also missing a `simp` lemma for the inverse equivalence and a `@[simp]` tag on `ordinaryHermiteJet_apply`.
